candidates.claim: Codex's claim is true in every part. The header contract at amx_attn_iface.hpp:102 and :156 says the Q pack buffer is "64B-aligned"; the only caller storage is `thread_local std::vector<uint16_t> amx_qpack` (self_attention.hpp:1361), sliced at :1413 by `batch_job_ix * Q_PACK_ELEMS_2048` = 2048 * 2 B = 4096 B (iface:83-84), so every slice has the same residue mod 64 as `data()`.
